# @sohrabi/tooltip (vendored)

- Version: 2.0.0
- Source: https://github.com/sohrabi/tooltip
- Upstream file: `dist/tooltip.min.js` (copied verbatim as `tooltip.min.js`)
- License: ISC (see `LICENSE`)
- Usage: `initTooltip()` global (`window.initTooltip` / `window.SohrabiTooltip.initTooltip`).
  Add `data-tooltip="..."` to any element; see https://github.com/XjSv/Cooked/issues/182.

Do not edit `tooltip.min.js` directly. To update, copy the new
`dist/tooltip.min.js` from upstream and bump the version in
`includes/class.cooked-admin-enqueues.php` (`cooked-tooltip` handle).
